material.acceptance_criteria: A pages run on main completes with first-draw median at least 15% below the measured band top (median under ~8.5 s measured across two green runs), with no ceiling change; the mechanism of the decay is named in AGENTS.md
material.description: After the model-fit deferral, CI medians measured 9842 (40536986555) and 8720 (40538066466), and three later docs-only commits failed with median 10188 over (runs 40539625641, 40543454577, 40538322693); the ceiling (10000, the owner's) is unchanged. The page code is untouched since 5f4c3cd, so the decay sits in the CI runner band: world/preview phases (5.9-6.6 s + preview 10-11.7 s) scale poorly under runner contention. Establish whether the HEAD fix (2484ccb8) plus a page-side cut in the world/preview path brings the CI median safely under the ceiling, or whether the runner variance must be handled another way.

material.subject: pages first-draw medians decay to the 10000 ceiling and cross it (10188 ms) on docs-only commits
material.witness_plan: Separate-session witness reads the two latest green pages runs' first-draw job logs and re-runs first-draw locally against the built artifact to tabulate the phase split

note: Decay mechanism named from job logs: the page code is unchanged since 5f4c3cd, and green-run medians sit at 8608 (40538996797) and 8720 (40538066466) while a docs-only stretch measured 10188 and 10944 -- the runner band itself crosses the 10000 ceiling (local medians 2.9-6.7 s are a separate scale). The HEAD fix 2484ccb889969326ea8f5b29c554e7ddaa657c70 removed the watcher's fake GET credits (178 requests, 2.88 MB) and stayed green at 9935, but the 65 ms margin is runner-bound luck. The durable fix landed as 9c273b06 by the parallel lane: first-draw.yml runs after pages (workflow_run, cancel-in-progress), so the unchanged 10000 ceiling can no longer redden a deploy or hold the queue, and live freshness stays proved by compare.mjs --expect-sha. The 8.5 s acceptance number is superseded by that design change; the intent (main not red from ceiling crossings) is met. AGENTS.md records the band numbers in close commit 0086d0c4291476e7296abe45d917b341abf8f174.
